text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026. July 29, 2026 Mayor Chow, during the morning session of the meeting, gave remarks about the late Penny Elizabeth Lamy and welcomed Penny Lamy’s family and friends who were present in the Council Chamber. Councillor Chernos Lin, during the morning session of the meeting, gave remarks about the late Sheldon Fainer. Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon the City Manager to recognize staff from the City of Toronto and its Agencies and Corporations on the planning and delivery of the FIFA World Cup 2026 in Toronto. The City Manager addressed City Council and gave remarks paying tribute to the many staff from the City of Toronto, its agencies and corporations, and external partners who helped make the World Cup a success.
